gloss: large room; shared (hospital) room; communal dressing room

definitions.explanation: A spacious room shared by multiple people. Most often refers to a shared hospital ward, but also used for the communal dressing room of junior actors or for any large multi-person room.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{病院|びょういん}の{大部屋|おおべや}にいる。
examples.english: My father is in a shared room at the hospital.

examples.japanese: {個室|こしつ}より{大部屋|おおべや}の{方|ほう}が{安|やす}い。
examples.english: A shared room is cheaper than a private room.

examples.japanese: {若手俳優|わかてはいゆう}たちは{楽屋|がくや}の{大部屋|おおべや}で{出番|でばん}を{待|ま}っていた。
examples.english: The young actors were waiting in the communal dressing room for their turn on stage.

notes:
Composed of {大|おお} (large) + {部屋|べや} (room; the rendaku form of {部屋|へや}). Most common in the hospital sense, in contrast to {個室|こしつ} (private room).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {病院|びょういん}の{大部屋|おおべや}: a shared hospital room
- {大部屋|おおべや}{病室|びょうしつ}: shared ward
- {大部屋|おおべや}{俳優|はいゆう}: a bit-part actor (one who shares a communal dressing room)
- {大部屋|おおべや}で{過|す}ごす: spend time in a large/shared room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {個室|こしつ}: private room — the opposite, especially for hospitals
- {相部屋|あいべや}: shared room (in lodging) — used for hotels and dorms
- {広間|ひろま}: large hall — emphasizes a large open space, often for gatherings
